## Problem

Describe the failure, limitation, or research question addressed by this change.

## Evidence

- [ ] A regression test fails before the change and passes after it.
- [ ] New trust assumptions are documented.
- [ ] The threat model is updated when required.
- [ ] Public-tree validation passes.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, sensitive raw logs, or embargoed findings are included.

## Claim boundary

State what this change supports and what it does not establish.

## AI assistance

Describe material AI assistance used for design, code, tests, documentation, or analysis. Write `None` when not applicable.
